title: Japanese-Style Beer-Steeped Dutch Cheese Wrap
description: A cozy Dutch dish featuring beer, yuzu-cure, and a satvik-friendly cheese pull, wrapped in a ti-leaf vessel.
instructions: Steep 1 cup of beer in a saucepan over low heat for 10 minutes.
Whisk 2 tbsp of yuzu-cure with 1 tsp of grated ginger until smooth.
Combine 1/2 cup of grated cheese, 1/4 cup of chopped chives, and 1/4 cup of chopped scallions in a bowl.
Add the yuzu-cure mixture and stir until combined.
Place 1/2 oz of the cheese mixture onto a ti-leaf wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Roll the wrap into a neat cylinder and press the edges to seal.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add 1 tbsp of oil.
Place the wraps seam-side down in the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional yuzu-cure and chives if desired.
